text.session-monitoring: watching Claude Code sessions across VS Code windows
text.notifications: overlay cards for finished or waiting sessions, the notifications setting and old hook cleanup
text.file-graph: browsing the project as a graph of files and their relations, with platform tabs, search, filters and a detail panel
text.lantern-sections: rbac, states, db and facts blocks under the map
text.pull-requests: pull request records, their open or merged state from the host, the list, the card with its description and changed-file highlighting
text.serve-web: embedded VS Code serve-web server and editor tab
text.agent-runs: launching and tracking Claude agents and subagents
text.code-insight: reading code and diffs with syntax and semantic highlighting and change explainers
text.skill-installer: installing and listing Claude Code skills
text.delegate-runs: delegated worktree runs: preflight, permissions, pull request creation and checks of what a delegate did
text.process-memory: read-only view of the memory Lantern's process tree uses, by category, project and process
text.macro-view: the Macro view: feature blocks, the links between them and the outside systems, and what a pull request touches
text.product-areas: product areas, the top level of the Macro view that groups features, and the areas file with its quality checks
text.map-setup: building and refreshing the map: the setup skill, its progress screen, language choice and validation
text.map-vocabulary: keeping feature and outside-system names consistent: retag, the systems list and the vocabulary checks
text.map-sync: keeping the map true after each change and recording the pull request in it
text.skill-checks: checking the bundled skills on small fixture projects, offline or end to end against a mock host
text.review-screen: the pull request review screen: file list, file or diff pane and graph with draggable dividers and hideable areas
text.review-comments: inline comments on code and diff lines and the fix requests collected for an agent
text.pr-explain: asking Claude to explain what changed in one pull request file
text.pr-flow: the Flow view: plain stories of who does what in a pull request and what changes for them
text.run-cost: measuring what a delegate run costs per phase, tool and agent, and comparing it with a baseline
text.planning: planning a change as a plan file: impact computed from the map, stages with questions, approval by section, and item progress ticked by pull requests
text.integrations: accounts for GitHub, Bitbucket and Jira added with a pasted token, the account each project uses, and the credentials handed to agents and delegate scripts
text.commands-keymap: the command table shared by main and renderer, shortcuts matched in main on every window and user bindings in settings, and the app menu items built from the same table
text.command-palette: the command palette dialog that lists and runs the registered commands with their shortcuts and recent use, the sidebar Search commands field that opens it, and the explain.open and explain.popout commands it can run
text.app-diagnostics: a local, redacted log of Lantern's own errors, crashes and editor-server problems, a live Diagnostics view, and a report the user can open on GitHub
text.app-updates: finding a newer release by itself, installing it on a Mac only when no session, run or terminal would be ended, a release notice with a link elsewhere, and the Check for Updates item and its setting
